text:
mia: FYI opened a docs PR with a few compact examples for function/tool calling edgecases (nullable arrays, union object/array responses). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5132
sam: can you list which SDK snippets need edits?
mia: Python example under 'tool-output-shapes' and JS snippet in 'parsing nullable fields'
devon: add a 1-line example for the case where a tool sometimes returns a single object and sometimes an array - that confuses parsers.
mia: adding this minimal JSON example in the PR:```json
{"result": [{"id":"123","val":"ok"}]}
``` and a note that parsers should accept both `{"result": {...}}` and `{"result": [{...}]}`
andre: heads-up the docs linter caught a trailing comma in the JS snippet, pushed a quick fix to your branch.
kevin: SDK team asks for an explicit JS pattern showing `response?.result ?? []` for nullable arrays.
mia: added an inline snippet showing `const items = response?.result ?? []` and also the defensive normalize pattern.
sam: please also include a brief guardrail suggestion: validate `maxArrayLength` and provide a fallback strategy (call tool vs. model-only).
mia: done - kept it short and added the rationale sentence.
docs-bot: build started for PR 5132 - docs-lint, examples-smoke, spellcheck
kevin: small nit - internal RFC link moved, can you point to /rfc/structured-output-v2 instead?
mia: updated links and rebased.
devon: add an SDK test snippet; suggestion:```js
const res = await client.callTool('finder', input);
const items = Array.isArray(res.result) ? res.result : (res.result ? [res.result] : []);
expect(items).toBeInstanceOf(Array);
```
kevin: perfect. also added a one-line ops note: if tool outputs are stable, prefer prefix-caching to avoid re-requesting the tool on every call. small perf win.
mia: included a TL;DR at the top for quick scanning and a short 'when to use toolcall' checklist.
sam: i will review in ~30 and merge if ok. thanks for the quick turnaround. :sparkles:
mia: thanks! ping me if reviewers spot anything else. :pray:
docs-bot: PR 5132 merged by sam - docs deploy queued
kevin: tracked under release notes -> "Docs: toolcall examples & nullable outputs"
mia: closing the loop. if customers report followups we'll spin up a KB with reproductions and a simple repro harness.
